metadata.title: Sparse Distance Reconstruction from Molecular Dynamics
metadata.source_dataset: ATLAS Standardized Molecular Dynamics (CHARMM36m, 100 ns explicit solvent triplicates)
metadata.limitation_note: This three-protein pilot supports further evaluation. Baseline configuration, nested selection/tuning and aggregate uncertainty require correction before claiming method superiority.
metadata.skill_definition: Zero matches the development-mean baseline; higher is better; negative values are worse.

metadata.name: Uteroglobin

case_studies.title: Investigating Intramolecular Dynamics vs Drug Binding
case_studies.summary: The original research question asked whether small-molecule compounds could bind cancer-associated proteins (such as c-Myc or mutant p53). The current CHARA framework specifically investigates whether a minimal set of residue-pair distances can reconstruct other distances across independent simulations. It has not answered the original drug-binding question.

case_studies.title: cMYC Centered Diagnostic & Simulation Limitations
case_studies.summary: Evaluation of c-Myc monomer chain E yielded a retrospective test-centered diagnostic skill of approximately +0.207, with 63.05% of MSE improvement coming from variance error reduction. However, rigorous audit identified limitations in the custom simulation setup: coarse-grained topologies, 349 harmonic elastic network restraints, and evaluation on an isolated monomer rather than the full simulated heterotetramer assembly.

case_studies.title: Standard All-Atom CHARMM36m Benchmark on ATLAS
case_studies.summary: To address simulation caveats, CHARA was evaluated on independent atomistic triplicates from the ATLAS repository across 3 structurally distinct proteins: 1utg_A (all-alpha, skill 0.386), 2cg7_A (all-beta, skill 0.319), and 2j6b_A (alpha+beta, skill 0.406). M8 worst-direction transfer demonstrated robust reconstruction across 9 held-out runs without custom force-field artifacts.

case_studies.title: Expanded Multi-Protein Panel & Baseline Calibration
case_studies.summary: The proposed 12-additional-protein study remains Planned unless its actual executed evidence is available; an experimental design is not a completed result. Nested sensor selection tuning, baseline QR rank calibration, and aggregate bootstrap uncertainty bounds must be resolved before claiming method superiority.
